**The setting.** It is a plugin option plus host environment variables, not an authorable spec key. `Metadata-protocol: none`, and `Clause-②: yes (widening)` because it is off by default.

**The file surface adds:**
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/direct-sign-in.ts` (new), `auth-manager.ts`, `auth-plugin.ts`;

**Behaviour:**
- "Local sign-in off" is decided on the page only in this PR. The server's password sign-in is unchanged, so the break-glass path ADR-0135 D5.2 keeps stays reachable. A server-side refusal waits for the maintainer's ruling text.
- The OAuth client hand-off on `/login` is not redirected.
- The return path is kept only when it is a same-origin relative path. Any other value is replaced by the Console root.

repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Ruling text relayed 2026-11-14T03:07Z, on the maintainer's request in seat session `session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9`: 「server agent 项目读不到 cloud 仓库，请把原文贴到两张卡上」. This card carries ruling 8 of objectstack-ai/cloud#4465 (private repo); ruling 10 sets the hosted local path. Below is the verbatim text of that card's body as last edited at 2026-11-14T03:05Z. The cloud-side half (hosted default on, local path off, the cloud sign-in page showing the organization's name) is objectstack-ai/cloud#4471, blocked by this card.

### Rulings 8 and 10 (the maintainer, 2026-11-13), verbatim

> 8. **Direct redirect to the identity provider is a platform feature, on by default in the cloud.** The maintainer, verbatim: 「开了单点登录后也可以设成「直接跳转身份提供方」，这个应该顺便开发平台统一的功能吧」 and 「只是云端默认打开」.
>    - The framework gains one setting: when SSO is configured, an unauthenticated visit skips the environment's sign-in page and goes straight to the configured identity provider, then returns to the original page.
>    - The local sign-in path is configurable. Self-hosted can keep a hidden path (for example `/login?local=1`). Hosted has it off (ruling 10).
>    - Self-hosted deployments with their own IdP can turn it on. Hosted environments have it on by default, with the cloud as the provider. The cloud sign-in page shows the organization's name and explains refusals (not a member under D5.1; invitation not accepted).
>
> 10. **Hosted has no local break-glass admin.** The maintainer chose 「A」.
>    - No hosted environment sets a local password for anyone, and existing owner break-glass passwords are invalidated.
>    - Emergency access is a platform-operator procedure, audited: the platform-admin `disable_platform_sso` / `enable_platform_sso` from cloud#3134, or a one-time recovery link.
>    - Self-hosted deployments keep local admins.
>    - This supersedes cloud#3132's "keep a break-glass local admin" for hosted.

### Ruling recorded after the body (comment 6870693029 on cloud#4465)

> d-2 应急入口不考虑 d-3 同意

For this card: D-2 means no one-time recovery link is built, so ruling 10's "or a one-time recovery link" is not pursued. The hosted local sign-in path stays off with no emergency reopening. The configurable local path in ruling 8 still applies to self-hosted deployments.

Third claim amendment to this seat's claim 6870084529 on #33183 · 2026-11-14T04:35Z: the file surface adds the `LoginForm` of `@object-ui/auth` (under `ui/packages/auth/`) and its pin. When `/auth/config` serves `features.localSignIn: 'off'`, the form hides the email and password form, sign-up and the break-glass link in every state, as it already does when `emailPassword.enabled` is false. This covers the two states that still fall back to the default page: an OAuth client hand-off, and `directSignIn` refined to false because no provider can start. It carries ruling 8 and ruling 10 on cloud#4465 as quoted on this card (comment 6870716068): hosted has the local path off, with no emergency reopening. A self-hosted `hidden` local path is unchanged.
